batchMint mints in a caller-supplied unbounded `for (i; i < count; ++i)` loop (V2:419). Self-DoS only (caller pays for each mint and chooses count); no third-party griefing. Matches the ledgered L-02 class (e35388bf, submitted) on the original BatchNFTMinter, reproduced on the multi-token variant. Human to confirm reconciliation to e35388bf and Low ranking.

batchMint mints ERC1155 to a caller-controlled `recipient` in a loop with the reward payout (step 9) and dust sweep (step 10) occurring AFTER the mints — the classic pattern where onERC1155Received could re-enter mid-loop. MITIGATED here: batchMint carries nonReentrant (V2:367), and the reward snapshot is taken BEFORE the loop so a re-entrant mint cannot inflate the payout. Distinct from the frozen deployed BatchNFTMinter which LACKS the guard (ledger M-02 c847207c open, Q-02 d0ed2cf4 wont-fix) — that instance is out of this change scope. Human to confirm the guard fully closes it on the new contract.
presentMitigations: reward pot snapshotted before the mint loop
